passages.title: Common threshold family and its two derivatives
inference_obligations: Identify the common threshold family with the actual smoother using FaceSmoother.shiftOffsets_F.
Differentiate the logistic family and the logarithm of its positive envelope; the zero-weight case is handled separately before taking logs.

∀ {T h : ℝ},
  0 ≤ T →
    0 < h →
      ∀ (s : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (RectangleCLTArxivV1.thresholdLogistic T h) (h⁻¹ * RectangleCLTArxivV1.thresholdEnvelope T h s) s

∀ {T h : ℝ},
  0 < T →
    0 < h →
      ∀ (s : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.log (RectangleCLTArxivV1.thresholdEnvelope T h t))
          (h⁻¹ * (1 - 2 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.thresholdLogistic T h s)) s

passages.title: Both fundamental-theorem integrations and the exact e/2 comparison
inference_obligations: Bound the absolute logarithmic derivative by 1/h and integrate from zero to the arbitrary positive or negative shift.
Integrate F_s prime over [-h,h] and derive the exact printed e/2 pointwise comparison, including the zero-weight case.

passages.title: Shared clocks, fixed-width layer averaging and expectation
inference_obligations: Use the same exponential clocks for both threshold shifts and prove nesting of the actual random rectangles.
Convert the difference of probabilities to the probability of the fixed-width layer and integrate the uniform threshold premise.
Use h≥4δ and exp(1)≤4 to preserve the public bound 4*C0*h*κ without a logarithmic factor.

expanded_types.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin p → ℝ))
  [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {M : ℝ},
  (∀ (r : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p),
      r.faces = s.faces →
        μ.real {x | (∀ f ∈ r.faces, r.faceScore f x ≤ s.bandwidth) ∧ ¬∀ f ∈ r.faces, r.faceScore f x ≤ -s.bandwidth} ≤
          M) →
    ∫ (x : Fin p → ℝ), s.F x * (1 - s.F x) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp 1 / 2 * M

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m r : ℕ} [inst_1 : NeZero m] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  Measurable X →
    ∀ (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h M : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        (∀ (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
            μ.real {ω | X ω ∈ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianPolyhedronLayer U b h} ≤ M) →
          ∫ (ω : Ω),
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h (X ω) *
                (1 - RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h (X ω)) ∂μ ≤
            Real.exp 1 / 2 * M

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m r : ℕ} [inst_1 : NeZero m] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  Measurable X →
    ∀ (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {δ κ C₀ h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < h →
            4 * δ ≤ h →
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicBoundaryBound μ X U δ κ C₀ →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun ω =>
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h (X ω) *
                        (1 - RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h (X ω)))
                    μ ∧
                  ∫ (ω : Ω),
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h (X ω) *
                        (1 - RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h (X ω)) ∂μ ≤
                    4 * C₀ * h * κ

passages.title: Average the positive-order translated derivative bound
inference_obligations: Integrate the genuine translated supremum using the proved local logistic derivative envelope.
Keep the product of the fixed projected direction norms outside the expectation and identify h^(-(q-1)) with h^(1-q) for positive integer q.

expanded_types.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m r q : ℕ} [inst_1 : NeZero m] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  Measurable X →
    ∀ (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℝ) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {δ κ C₀ h ρ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < h →
            4 * δ ≤ h →
              0 ≤ ρ →
                ρ ≤ h →
                  1 ≤ q →
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicBoundaryBound μ X U δ κ C₀ →
                      ∀ (z : Fin q → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun ω =>
                              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.translatedFaceDerivativeSupremum
                                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h) U ρ z (X ω))
                            μ ∧
                          ∫ (ω : Ω),
                              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.translatedFaceDerivativeSupremum
                                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight U a h) U ρ z (X ω) ∂μ ≤
                            RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicDerivativeConstant C₀ q / h ^ (q - 1) * κ *
                              ∏ i, RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.faceProjectionNorm U (z i)
